title: Track length in minutes
statementMd:
For tracks 1 to 5 show title and length as minutes rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `title`, `minutes`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, ROUND(seconds / 60.0, 2) AS minutes FROM tracks WHERE id <= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
